milestones.title: GMP manufacturing
milestones.description:
(Good Manufacturing Practices)

Produce clinical-grade materials under strict quality controls for human use.

milestones.title: Phase 1/2
milestones.description: A combination of the first two phases of clinical testing, designed to evaluate both the safety and efficacy of a drug in a single trial.

milestones.title: Phase 3
milestones.description: Confirm the drug's efficacy, monitor side effects in a larger population, and compare it to current standard treatments.

milestones.title: Orphan Drug Designation & Rare Pediatric Disease Designation
milestones.description: Submit application for ODD and RPDD

milestones.title: IND submission
milestones.description: Submit an Investigational New Drug (IND) application to begin human clinical trials.

milestones.title: Toxicology & Biodistribution
milestones.description: Assess potential harmful effects of a treatment in model systems before human trials.

milestones.title: Pre-IND meeting
milestones.description: Discuss the preclinical data, manufacturing, plans for clinical testing and get feedback on the proposed clinical trial design, preclinical data, and regulatory requirements.

milestones.title: Patient-derived cell line
milestones.description: Grow cells taken directly from patients to study disease characteristics.

milestones.title: Mouse model
milestones.description: Model genetic impacts on disease in order to understand the disease biology and the impacts of treatment on disease.

milestones.title: Basic science
milestones.description: Understand the fundamental biological processes that contribute to a disease

milestones.title: Mouse model
milestones.description: Model genetic impacts on disease in order to understand the disease biology and the impacts of treatment on disease.

milestones.title: Drug screen
milestones.description: Test many compounds rapidly in a disease model to find those with promising effects against the target.

milestones.title: Engineered cell line
milestones.description: Create modified cells that express or silence specific genes for research insights or models patient mutations.

milestones.title: Dose finding study
milestones.description: Test a range of doses of the treatment to determine levels at which it has a biological effect and is safe.

milestones.title: Other disease model
milestones.description: E.g. yeast, c.elegans, drosophilia, macaque, pig, dog, zebrafish, organoids, or in-silico models

milestones.title: Toxicology study
milestones.description: Assess potential harmful effects of a treatment in model systems before human trials.
